mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; adalimumab may indirectly affect cytochrome P450 activity through modulation of inflammatory cytokines, and additive anticholinergic effects may occur.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic side effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, constipation, cognitive effects); consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if necessary.
